mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_sessions WHERE (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY updated_at DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_sessions (session_id, title, user_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{title}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_chat_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
